purpose: Original interactive obstetric teaching room with clothed fictional adult pregnant patient; no patient photograph or health record.

upstream.rights_holders_as_recorded: Data Collection AB, Joel Palmius, Jonas Hauquier; target files also record the transfer from Manuel Bastioni. See preserved per-file headers.
upstream.software_distinction: MakeHuman source code is AGPL; only its explicitly CC0 core data files were used. No MakeHuman code or add-on is executed or included.

original_work: Room architecture, furniture, bedding, curtain, monitor, cables, independent transducer meshes
Maternity gown derived from core body topology, original woven dot texture and coverage
Pregnancy surface deformation, semi-reclined arm/hand pose, hair surface and swept strands, face complexion and iris detail
modifications: Apply asian-female-young and universal-female-young-averagemuscle-averageweight core targets at weight 1
Uniform base scale 0.111; pose changes are for this illustrative fictional adult and are not a clinical anatomical measurement
Clothed late-pregnancy silhouette, covered lower body, bedside left-hand interaction surface
Official Asian face-unit targets supply bilateral Blink, mouth-open Talk, eyebrows-down/mouth-compression Contraction
Original Breath morph adds a small smooth chest rise; other body parts retain four compatible named keys
Core brown-eye texture resized to 256 px; original full texture retained in editable source folder
Export-only static mesh batching by material; editable .blend retains separate room parts, curves and modifiers

runtime.axes: +X room right, +Y up, bed head toward -Z
runtime.head_children: Eyes, brows and batched hair/iris meshes inherit Patient_head; preserve base transforms and use only small nod/turn offsets.
runtime.hand_pivot: Patient_left_hand and Patient_right_hand origins are surface centroids, suitable for small gesture offsets; do not rotate through a wide angle.
runtime.monitor_uv: Single quad facing +Z; full 0-1 UV. In GLB, upper left is (0,0), lower right is (1,1). CanvasTexture.flipY=false.
runtime.probe_motion: Independent FHR_transducer / TOCO_transducer nodes; their *_face children move with them. Raycast Patient_chest to keep small changes on the surface. Suggested X-only adjustment approximately 0.03 m.
runtime.clinical_scope: Device positions are schematic visual interaction locations on covered clothing, not clinical placement instruction or treatment simulation.

review.medical_content_approval: User review pending; this is illustrative synthetic teaching content.
